name: FramePlayer
summary:
FramePlayer is a video player for your own videos.

GET VIDEOS ON IT IN SECONDS
Turn on Wi-Fi upload in the Library. Open the address it shows on your computer or phone (or screenshot the QR code with your headset and tap it on your phone), enter the two-digit code and drop your videos in. They go straight into your library. No cables, no extra apps.

PLAYS WHAT YOU HAVE
